name: Screen Shake
desc: An impact camera pass: bass hits and downbeats punch a spring-decay whole-frame jolt with shockwave rings and motion streaks over a continuously unstable handheld vignette.

threshold.doc: audio bass level that fires a jolt

act.doc: multi-minute program: combat jolts every bar / quake rare heavy rolls / pulse soft bumps every beat
